title: baseline settlement: irreducible within the accepted composition + quantitative weak-field bound
verdict: B is IRREDUCIBLE within the accepted composition (canon: declared premise of C-GRV-001's additive ledger; demonstrated through the API: unit b-coefficient under every usable regulator, b-free regulator differences, shift carrying no additive constant). New quantitative result: weak-field validity of the consumer requires B >= (M/R)/eps* - Delta, i.e. B_min ~ 4.54 x Delta (marginal), ~45.6 (1% field), ~456 (0.1% field) -- any escape from the criterion-3 strong-coupling wall via B is necessarily BARE-DOMINATED: the sector's gravity would then be mostly bare Newton coupling, not induced coupling.
